provenance.excluded: All old experiments, modified sources, event timings, and NCU results.

equations.recurrence: S_(p+1)=TF32(S_p)*TF32(M_p)+N_p, accumulating in Float32; exact implementation TF32 numerical rounding applies.
equations.compute: convert[p] after store[p-1]; copyN[p] after convert[p] and Nready[p]; GEMM[p] after copyN[p], Mready[p], and done-slot availability; store[p] after GEMM completion; next convert after store.
equations.resource_calendar: Each nonpreemptive node starts after all dependencies and the previous occupying node on its resource; dependencies are source, exclusive ordering/arbitration is scenario.
equations.ideal_resource_floor: max(HBM work,SMEM work,TMEM work,conversion work,TF32 work,source-dependency critical-path floor); this is a lower bound, not a realized schedule.

notes: GMEM request counts include last fixed-state duplicate store; requests are not guaranteed HBM traffic because cache behavior is unknown.
TMEM counts exclude internal MMA operand/accumulator traffic; its resource cost is represented by tensor service.
SMEM counts include TMA stage writes and compute N reads; tensor-internal M reads are excluded from the explicit shared-memory service ledger.

hardware.scalar_SFU: No exp/log/SFU in K3 payload; control/address scalar instruction work is uncounted and symbolic.

copy_geometry.condition: Ideal packet floors need zero issue/tail cost and independent engine overlap; source does not establish achieved overlap.

numeric_scenario.status: Conservative source-causal DAG scheduling scenario, not fitted or measured latency.

scheduler.resources: HBM, SMEM, TMEM, CVT, TF32, control; exclusive each. This equal-share HBM queue models one CTA on an active SM, not chip-wide capacity.
scheduler.arbitration: Ready compute memory nodes priority0, producer nodes priority1; stable node creation order breaks ties. Transfers issue in source order but can complete asynchronously.
scheduler.algorithm: Complete all nodes at current timestamp; repeatedly start every ready node with a free resource in priority/stable order; zero-duration nodes retire immediately; advance to next completion; no resource co-occupancy.
scheduler.TMA_conservative: Whole-tile HBM transfer completes before whole-tile SMEM write begins; this intentionally does not claim realized TMA streaming.
scheduler.compute_conservative: Subcopy's resource services complete in source program order before next subcopy; asynchronous engine retirement may permit a faster actual schedule.
